_header:
Three finders in parallel (faithfulness, verdicts, coverage; general-purpose), dispatched ~15:51Z, all returned by ~15:55Z. The verdicts finder's report opened with a wrong count line, then corrected it; it says it did not read the references/ checklists.
Raw counts: faithfulness 4 (1 Important, 3 Nit), verdicts 7 (6 Important, 1 Nit), coverage 3 (2 Important, 1 Nit) = 14.
Duplicate merged: faithfulness F1 = verdicts F2 (R2-01).
Count line (merged): 13 findings: 8 Important, 5 Nit.
Routing (4.4): to the verifier (Important): R2-01 to R2-08. Straight to fix (Nit): R2-09 to R2-13.
Verifier: 3 Real, 5 Not real, 0 Style only. Dropped: R2-01, R2-03, R2-04, R2-06, R2-07 (5/8). Kept: 3 Important + 5 Nit = 8.
Status: fixed 6 (R2-02, R2-05, R2-08, R2-09, R2-10, R2-12); answered 1 (R2-13); open 1 (R2-11); Pre-existing 0.
Attribution (diff round1 vs round0): kept findings quoting a line round 1 changed: R2-02 (CO-09, added in round 1), R2-05 (Refund not confirmed reported, added in round 1) = 2. Quoting a line round 1 did not change: R2-08, R2-09 (the trajectory line is unchanged; it is left over from the incomplete R1-16 fix), R2-10, R2-11, R2-12, R2-13 = 6.
Each finding below is the first source finder's text verbatim, renumbered R2-nn; the verifier line is verbatim.

R2-01.decision: Dropped. Refutation: G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done'. I read G-03: in CO-S14/CO-S15 no refund was attempted, so G-03 requires the agent to say the refund was not done; the dimension's 'that no refund was issued' follows from a rule the scenarios illustrate. I agree.

R2-02.status: fixed. No-date clause added to the five failure-path dimensions; CO-09 in Illustrates of 8 scenarios.

R2-03.decision: Dropped. Refutation: the cited checklist item 'the lookup returns more than one plausible match, or none (ambiguous match)' covers ambiguity, which the 'more than one ... placed or processing' row and CO-S02 handle; 'cancel both' is in no input. I read the checklist line and the packet: the evidence does not show what the finding claims, and the request is the finder's own. I agree.

R2-04.decision: Dropped. Refutation: §5.2 'A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call' with the CO-S23 dimension 'never says ... that staff will follow up'. Same refutation as R1-15; I read both again and agree the verdict is the same under either reading.

R2-05.status: fixed. Dimension lists the forms that count.

R2-06.decision: Dropped. Refutation: the failure row for an unanswered first CO-A3, 'Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01.', is unconditional. I read the row: skipping the retry departs from it, so failing that run is the intended verdict. I agree.

R2-07.decision: Dropped. Refutation: Appendix A 'The agent may repeat CO-A1 without limit; only commit calls are bounded' and packet change 4 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit'. I read both: 1 or 20 unanswered lookups both pass by the inputs, and an agent that never yields misses the Required CO-A4; no trajectory gets two verdicts. I agree.

R2-08.status: fixed. Forbidden 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn.' added to 17 confirm scenarios.

R2-09.status: fixed. Trajectory results no longer show a failure reason.

R2-11.status: open. The inputs do not settle whether the case-3 re-read applies when the retry answers; only the user can decide.

R2-12.status: fixed. Shipped/cancelled failure rows cover the customer's only order when none was named; CO-S05 row 4.

R2-13.status: answered. Stands: CO-04 defines the full proposal; CO-S08's question is not one, and no verdict depends on it.
